GET /accounts/{account_id}/email/sending.description: Lists email suppressions for the specified account.
Retrieves a single email suppression for the specified account.

Lists every active Email Sending suppression owned by the account: sending-domain suppressions first, then account-wide suppressions (including legacy rows with internal zone memberships). Each group is newest first.

schema.description: Maximum number of suppressions to return per page.
Opaque pagination cursor returned as `result_info.next_cursor`. It carries the filters that produced it.
A complete address is an exact match; a value ending in `@` matches that username across every domain. Prefix searches may return short intermediate pages while the bounded account scan advances.
Filter to suppressions with this reason.
Filter by scope: `account` returns only account-wide suppressions, `sending_domain` only sending-domain suppressions. Omit to list both, sending-domain suppressions first.

reason.description: Why the address is suppressed: `manual`, `complaint`, `hard_bounce`, `soft_bounce`, or `policy`.

scope.description: Where the suppression applies: `account` for every sending domain of the account, or `sending_domain` for one envelope MAIL FROM domain.

POST /accounts/{account_id}/email/sendin.description: Creates a new email suppression for the specified account.

Creates a suppression for every sending domain of the account (default) or for one sending domain (`scope.type = sending_domain`). Creating an existing active suppression returns its identifier. If a mutable legacy zone-linked account row already exists, it is promoted without changing its identifier.

expires_at.description: Expiration timestamp for the suppression. Omit or set to null for a permanent suppression that never expires.

note.description: Advisory note for this suppression. Not enforced or validated beyond length.

scope.description: Where the suppression applies. Omit for `{ "type": "account" }`, which blocks the recipient for every sending domain of the account.

type.description: Blocks the recipient for every sending domain of the account.

POST /accounts/{account_id}/email/sendin.summary: Bulk import account Email Sending suppressions
POST /accounts/{account_id}/email/sendin.description: Imports up to 1,000 Email Sending suppressions in one request. Each item applies to every sending domain of the account (default) or to one sending domain.

items.description: Suppressions to import. Items with the same email address and scope are deduplicated before processing.

expires_at.description: Expiration timestamp for the suppression. Omit or set to null for a permanent suppression that never expires.

note.description: Advisory note for this suppression. Not enforced or validated beyond length.

scope.description: Where the suppression applies. Omit for `{ "type": "account" }`, which blocks the recipient for every sending domain of the account.

type.description: Blocks the recipient for every sending domain of the account.
Blocks the recipient only for mail whose envelope MAIL FROM uses `value`.

value.description: The sending domain to suppress for: the domain part of the envelope MAIL FROM. It is lowercased and trailing dots are removed. Internationalized domains must use the ASCII (punycode) form. Ownership is not checked; a domain the account does not send from never matches.

deduplicated.description: Number of items dropped because their email address and scope repeated an earlier item in this request. Counted once and excluded from `items`.

errors.description: Number of items that failed to import due to an unexpected error.

invalid.description: Number of items with an invalid email address or sending domain.

items.description: Per-item results, in the same order as the request body.

email.description: The submitted email address for this item.

error.description: Human-readable error message. Present when `status` is `invalid`, `error`, or `skipped`.

id.description: The created or promoted suppression's identifier. Present when `status` is `processed`.

index.description: Zero-based index of this item in the request body.

scope.description: Where the suppression applies: `account` for every sending domain of the account, or `sending_domain` for one envelope MAIL FROM domain.

type.description: Blocks the recipient for every sending domain of the account.
Blocks the recipient only for mail whose envelope MAIL FROM uses `value`.

value.description: The sending domain: the domain part of the envelope MAIL FROM, lowercase, without a trailing dot.

processed.description: Number of items successfully created or promoted.

skipped.description: Number of items skipped because the existing suppression is not customer-managed (for example, a read-only policy suppression).

total.description: Total number of items in the request body, including duplicates.

code.description: Machine-readable error code, when one applies: `invalid_scope_value` (the sending domain is not valid), `scope_immutable` (scope cannot change after creation), or `scope_value_requires_type` (`scope_value` needs `scope_type=sending_domain`).
